(async()=>{ for(let i=0;i<80;i++){ if(window.__app && __app.player.video.readyState>=2) break; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,250)); } __app.showTab('player'); __app.player.video.pause(); return 'ok'; })()

(async()=>{ const p=__app.player.xrPanel; p.show(true); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300)); const url=p.canvas.toDataURL('image/png'); await vr180.saveSnapshot(url, 'vrpanel_test'); const rects=p.rects.map(r=>r.kind+(r.b?':'+r.b.id:'')+(r.c?':'+r.c.label:'')).join(' '); return rects; })()

(async()=>{ const p=__app.player.xrPanel; const v=__app.player.video; const was=v.paused; const r=p.rects.find(x=>x.b&&x.b.id==='play'); p.click(r.x+r.w/2, r.y+r.h/2); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,500)); const now=v.paused; p.click(r.x+r.w/2, r.y+r.h/2); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300)); return 'paused before ' + was + ' -> after click ' + now + ' -> after 2nd click ' + v.paused; })()

(async()=>{ const p=__app.player.xrPanel; const v=__app.player.video; const r=p.rects.find(x=>x.kind==='seek'); p.click(r.x + r.w*0.5, r.y + r.h/2); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,500)); return 'seek to half: ' + v.currentTime.toFixed(2) + ' of ' + v.duration.toFixed(2); })()

(async()=>{ const p=__app.player.xrPanel; const v=__app.player.video; const t0=v.currentTime; const r=p.rects.find(x=>x.b&&x.b.id==='fwd'); p.click(r.x+r.w/2, r.y+r.h/2); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,400)); const t1=v.currentTime; const rv=p.rects.find(x=>x.b&&x.b.id==='vold'); const vol0=v.volume; p.click(rv.x+rv.w/2, rv.y+rv.h/2); return '+10s: ' + t0.toFixed(1) + ' -> ' + t1.toFixed(1) + ' · volume ' + vol0.toFixed(2) + ' -> ' + v.volume.toFixed(2); })()

(async()=>{ const p=__app.player.xrPanel; const r=p.rects.find(x=>x.b&&x.b.id==='next'); p.hover={ x: r.x+10, y: r.y+10 }; p.redraw(); await vr180.saveSnapshot(p.canvas.toDataURL('image/png'), 'vrpanel_hover'); p.hover=null; p.show(false); return 'hidden ' + !p.visible; })()
